name: Cá song soup
summary: Canh cá song is a soup of cá song, served in the same course as the sour clam soup and riêu hà.
origin: Hạ Long. Cá song is also among the live fish at the market under Núi Bài Thơ.
howToEat: A soup, in the same course as the sour clam soup.
where: The soup course of the ordinary meal. The live fish are at the market under Núi Bài Thơ from 4:30 until before 7:00, on the 6 May 2020 account.
seoTitle: Canh ca song — cá song soup in Ha Long
seoDescription: Canh cá song is one of the three soups in the Hạ Long seafood meal.
